title: Asbestos schools (AHERA): responsibilities, inspections, sampling and assessment practice questions
description: Practice questions on AHERA schools rules: LEA duties, definitions, inspections, reinspections, sampling, analysis and assessment (40 CFR 763.80-763.88).

questions.question: Under 763.80(a), a local education agency hires a contractor to carry out its duties under the rule. Who remains responsible for the proper performance of those duties?

options.A: The contractor alone
options.B: The local education agency
options.C: The EPA Regional Asbestos Coordinator
options.D: The Governor of the State

questions.explanation: 763.80(a) says: "Local education agencies may contractually delegate their duties under this rule, but they remain responsible for the proper performance of those duties."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.80, Scope and purpose (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 763.83, when is ACM "accessible"?

options.A: When it can be reached from the floor without a ladder
options.B: When it is visible without removing any ceiling tiles
options.C: When it is located in a functional space used by students
options.D: When it is subject to disturbance by school building occupants or custodial or maintenance personnel in the course of their normal activities

questions.explanation: "Accessible when referring to ACM means that the material is subject to disturbance by school building occupants or custodial or maintenance personnel in the course of their normal activities."

questions.question: Under 763.83, who designates a "functional space"?

options.A: A person accredited to prepare management plans, design abatement projects, or conduct response actions
options.B: The laboratory that analyzes the bulk samples
options.C: The school principal
options.D: The State's lead agency

questions.explanation: A functional space is a room, group of rooms, or homogeneous area "designated by a person accredited to prepare management plans, design abatement projects, or conduct response actions."

questions.question: Which of these is part of a "school building" as defined in 763.83?

options.A: An uncovered parking lot
options.B: A public street bordering the campus
options.C: A covered exterior walkway
options.D: An open-air bus loading lane

questions.explanation: The definition of school building includes "Any portico or covered exterior hallway or walkway."

questions.question: Under 763.83, damaged friable surfacing ACM becomes "significantly damaged friable surfacing ACM" when what is true?

options.A: The damage in a functional space is extensive and severe
options.B: The material is accessible to students
options.C: The material has been encapsulated
options.D: A single bulk sample shows more than 1 percent asbestos

questions.explanation: "Significantly damaged friable surfacing ACM means damaged friable surfacing ACM in a functional space where the damage is extensive and severe."

questions.question: Friable ACBM in a school is subject to major or continuing disturbance because of vibration. In 763.83, this circumstance is listed in the definition of which term?

options.A: Routine maintenance area
options.B: Potential damage
options.C: Potential significant damage
options.D: Damaged friable surfacing ACM

questions.explanation: Potential significant damage includes circumstances in which "The material is subject to major or continuing disturbance, due to factors including, but not limited to, accessibility or, under certain circumstances, vibration or air erosion." The definition of potential damage does not list this circumstance.

questions.question: Under 763.84(c), whom must the local education agency ensure are informed at least once each school year about inspections, response actions, and post-response action activities?

options.A: Only the accredited inspectors
options.B: Workers and building occupants, or their legal guardians
options.C: Only the EPA Regional Asbestos Coordinator
options.D: Only the Governor of the State

questions.explanation: The agency shall "Ensure that workers and building occupants, or their legal guardians, are informed at least once each school year about inspections, response actions, and post-response action activities."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.84, General local education agency responsibilities (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: An exterminator will work in a school for one day and may come in contact with asbestos. Under 763.84(d), what must the local education agency ensure the exterminator is provided?

options.A: Proof of State accreditation as an asbestos worker
options.B: A copy of the laboratory's analysis signatures
options.C: The full written assessment by the accredited inspector
options.D: Information regarding the locations of ACBM and suspected ACBM assumed to be ACM

questions.explanation: Short-term workers "(e.g., telephone repair workers, utility workers, or exterminators)" who may come in contact with asbestos "are provided information regarding the locations of ACBM and suspected ACBM assumed to be ACM."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.84, General local education agency responsibilities (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 763.84(g), what must the local education agency ensure about the person it designates to implement the section's requirements?

options.A: The person is an accredited inspector
options.B: The person is a State employee
options.C: The person is the school principal
options.D: The person receives adequate training to perform duties assigned under the section

questions.explanation: The agency shall "Ensure that the designated person receives adequate training to perform duties assigned under this section."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.84, General local education agency responsibilities (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 763.84(h), what must the local education agency consider when selecting accredited personnel?

options.A: Whether any conflict of interest may arise from the interrelationship among accredited personnel
options.B: Whether the personnel live in the same school district
options.C: Whether the personnel offer the lowest price
options.D: Whether the personnel were accredited in the same State as the school

questions.explanation: The agency shall "Consider whether any conflict of interest may arise from the interrelationship among accredited personnel and whether that should influence the selection of accredited personnel."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.84, General local education agency responsibilities (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A local education agency leases an office building in 2026 to use as a school building, and no emergency requires its use. When does 763.85(a)(2) require the building to be inspected?

options.A: Within 30 days after classes begin there
options.B: At the next reinspection of the agency's other buildings
options.C: Prior to use as a school building
options.D: Only if friable material is visible during a walk-through

questions.explanation: "Any building leased or acquired on or after October 12, 1988, that is to be used as a school building shall be inspected as described under paragraphs (a) (3) and (4) of this section prior to use as a school building." The 30-day period applies only where "emergency use of an uninspected building as a school building is necessitated."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.85, Inspection and reinspections (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 763.85(a)(4)(iv), from which homogeneous areas must the person inspecting collect and submit bulk samples for analysis?

options.A: Only areas of friable material larger than 1,000 ft2
options.B: Each homogeneous area that is not assumed to be ACM
options.C: Each homogeneous area that is assumed to be ACM
options.D: Only areas the designated person selects

questions.explanation: The inspector shall "Assume that some or all of the homogeneous areas are ACM, and, for each homogeneous area that is not assumed to be ACM, collect and submit for analysis bulk samples."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.85, Inspection and reinspections (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: During a reinspection, what does 763.85(b)(3)(ii) require for material that was previously considered nonfriable ACBM?

options.A: Visually inspect it and touch it to determine whether it has become friable since the last inspection or reinspection
options.B: Remove it before the reinspection report is filed
options.C: Collect at least three bulk samples from it
options.D: Mark it with a warning label and take no other step

questions.explanation: The reinspector shall "Visually inspect material that was previously considered nonfriable ACBM and touch the material to determine whether it has become friable since the last inspection or reinspection."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.85, Inspection and reinspections (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Thermal system insulation has retained its structural integrity and has an undamaged protective jacket that prevents fiber release. How does 763.85(c) say it shall be treated?

options.A: As friable ACBM that must be removed
options.B: As significantly damaged thermal system insulation ACM
options.C: As material that must be resampled at every reinspection
options.D: As nonfriable, subject only to periodic surveillance and preventive measures as necessary

questions.explanation: Such insulation "shall be treated as nonfriable and therefore is subject only to periodic surveillance and preventive measures as necessary."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 763.85, Inspection and reinspections (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A local education agency decides not to assume that a homogeneous area of nonfriable suspected ACBM is ACM. What does 763.86(d) require?

options.A: No sampling, because nonfriable material is never sampled
options.B: An accredited inspector shall collect bulk samples from the area in a manner sufficient to determine whether the material is ACM or not ACM
options.C: The designated person collects one sample from the area
options.D: Sampling only after the material becomes friable

questions.explanation: 763.86(d): if a homogeneous area of nonfriable suspected ACBM "is not assumed to be ACM, then an accredited inspector shall collect, in a manner sufficient to determine whether the material is ACM or not ACM, bulk samples from the homogeneous area."

questions.question: An accredited inspector has determined that the thermal system insulation in a homogeneous area is fiberglass. What does 763.86(b)(4) say about bulk samples from that area?

options.A: At least three must be collected in a randomly distributed manner
options.B: At least one must be collected
options.C: Bulk samples are not required to be collected from it
options.D: Samples must be composited before analysis

questions.explanation: "Bulk samples are not required to be collected from any homogeneous area where the accredited inspector has determined that the thermal system insulation is fiberglass, foam glass, rubber, or other non-ACBM."

questions.question: To save cost, a local education agency asks the laboratory to combine the bulk samples from one homogeneous area and run a single analysis. What does 763.87(b) set?

options.A: Combining is allowed if the laboratory is accredited
options.B: Combining is allowed for surfacing material only
options.C: Bulk samples shall not be composited for analysis and shall be analyzed for asbestos content by PLM
options.D: Combining is allowed if the result is reported as an average

questions.explanation: 763.87(b): "Bulk samples shall not be composited for analysis and shall be analyzed for asbestos content by PLM."

questions.question: A laboratory finishes analyzing a school's bulk samples. Under 763.87(d), what must be submitted to the person designated under 763.84 for inclusion in the management plan?

options.A: The name and address of each laboratory performing an analysis, the date of analysis, and the name and signature of the person performing the analysis
options.B: Only the percent of asbestos found, with no laboratory details
options.C: The remaining sample material, sealed and labeled
options.D: A photograph of each sample under the microscope

questions.explanation: "The name and address of each laboratory performing an analysis, the date of analysis, and the name and signature of the person performing the analysis shall be submitted to the person designated under § 763.84 for inclusion into the management plan within 30 days of the analysis."

questions.question: Under 763.88(d), whom shall the local education agency select to review the results of each inspection, reinspection, and assessment and recommend response actions in writing?

options.A: The laboratory that performed the analysis
options.B: The custodial supervisor
options.C: Any building occupant
options.D: A person accredited to develop management plans

questions.explanation: "The local education agency shall select a person accredited to develop management plans to review the results of each inspection, reinspection, and assessment."

questions.question: Under 763.88(b), what must the inspector do with the ACBM and suspected ACBM assumed to be ACM in the written assessment?

options.A: Estimate the cost of removal
options.B: Classify it into one of the listed categories and give reasons for the classification
options.C: Choose the response action to be performed
options.D: List the names of building occupants near it

questions.explanation: "The inspector shall classify and give reasons in the written assessment for classifying the ACBM and suspected ACBM assumed to be ACM in the school building into one of the following categories."
